query: Extract typed directed material anaphora relations from each complete tokenized snippet under the supplied annotation guideline.

task_definition.task: Extract typed directed material anaphora relations from each complete tokenized snippet under the supplied annotation guideline.
task_definition.input: sentences: token lists; flat zero-based inclusive token offsets
task_definition.output: record_id and relations by Coreference/Transformed/Reaction-associated/Work-up/Contained; each edge is [anaphor_ranges, antecedent_ranges]; preserve discontinuity.
task_definition.gold_semantics: Original published JSON edges. No transitive closure applied; not the official 2022 score.
task_definition.failure: ABSTAIN is execution failure, not a negative semantic label.
task_definition.downstream: Filter Work-up edges and project material sources, or group/count edges by type.
limitations: No patent entity grouping or independent confirmation
Conservative public example lexical exclusion is not complete leakage audit
No model or operator extraction run
